messages:
alex: Heads up — we're seeing a burst of 502s hitting hosted inference streaming endpoints over the last ~40m. Mostly /v1/stream calls, clients report early termination and no model output. Sample traces: trace-0a1b2c, trace-0d3e4f. Posting a short repro and logs below.
maria: Thanks Alex — is this isolated to a single region or tenant?
alex: US-WEST primary, hits across a handful of tenants (guest-heavy). Not limited to one customer. Seems concentrated on long-lived streaming requests (>20s).
tien: Noted. Envoy logs I pulled earlier showed `upstream reset` and `stream_closed` for the streams. Can you share a request example?
alex: Minimal curl (sanitized):
```
curl -v \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-small","stream":true,"input":"<big prompt>"}' \
  https://api.redwood-hosted.example/v1/stream
```
Response behavior: connection opens, a token or two, then client sees `502 Bad Gateway` and connection closed.
ops-bot: Incident created: INC-3948 (auto).
jordan: Any recent deploys to auth-proxy or midproxy?
alex: small auth-proxy rollback 2h ago, but error spike started ~45m ago — looks like later. Also, dedicated infra deploy to ingress happened 50m ago (nginx/envoy config tweak).
maria: I pulled auth-proxy metrics — 5xx from auth-proxy backend jumped coincident with the spike. CPU not saturated, but connection pool exhaustion on its outbound side (to tenant lookup) is visible: 95% used.
tien: Envoy snippet from edge node:
```
[warning] [upstream] upstream reset before response 'upstream_reset' details=\"connection failure: desc=\"transport: stream closed\"\"\n[error] [http] error_response: sending 502 to client, upstream failure
```
That aligns with conn resets from auth service.
maria: Hypothesis: auth-proxy outbound pool to identity/backing service is stalling under fanout; long streams hold auth connection longer causing midproxy to hit pool limits, then new streams get 502 when auth times out.
jordan: Is there a quick mitigation we can try to buy time for customers?
alex: Two quick options: 1) increase auth-proxy connection pool size and reduce per-connection idle timeout; 2) make ingress tolerate auth transient failures with a retry/fallback for streaming preflight (i.e., allow streaming to run with cached auth session for N seconds).
maria: Implementing (1) now in canary: bump outbound pool to 200, idle_keepalive 60s -> 30s. Also adding short circuit for auth lookup cache hit. Rolling to 10% in us-west.
tien: I'll instrument to capture `auth_lookup_latency` and `conn_pool_wait_count` per auth-proxy instance. Add a guard metric to alert at 75% pool usage.
alex: Repro steps for eng to trigger locally: 1) run loop of 200 concurrent streaming requests that do long polling (>30s), 2) throttle identity backend to add 150ms latency and drop some keepalives. Should reproduce pool exhaustion and 502.
maria: Canary result after 12m: 502 rate down ~78% for canary subset, connection wait spikes reduced. Rolling further to 35% while monitoring.
jordan: Noted. Can we communicate to customers? I'll send a short status note to affected folks: we deployed temporary auth-pool tuning + caching, monitoring, follow-up patch planned.
alex: Customer in thread confirmed partial improvement for their streaming jobs.
tien: Postmortem actions: - Harden auth-proxy pool management (auto-scale threads), - Add backpressure at client-side SDK to avoid thundering, - Add fallback routing to a secondary auth cluster, - Add richer head-of-line metrics for streaming requests.
maria: Filed follow-ups: TKT-1284 (auth-pool autoscale), TKT-1285 (ingress streaming fallback), TKT-1286 (SDK client backpressure).
ops-bot: Incident INC-3948 updated: mitigated -> monitoring.
alex: Thanks team. I'll keep watching traces and update if we see regression.
maria: Leaving this thread open for 6h then closing when stable. :thumbsup:
